name: bookstack-mcp
description: FastMCP server for managing BookStack instances
long_description: Expose consolidated BookStack tools over MCP for content CRUD, search, image gallery workflows, semantic search, batch operations, health checks, and runtime dashboards.

bookstackUrl.title: BookStack URL
bookstackUrl.description: Base URL of the BookStack instance, for example https://wiki.example.com.

hayhooksSearchUrl.title: Hayhooks search URL
hayhooksSearchUrl.description: Optional endpoint for semantic search. Leave empty if you do not use bookstack_semantic_search.

tools.name: bookstack_manage_content
tools.description: Unified CRUD operations for books, bookshelves, chapters, and pages.

tools.name: bookstack_list_content
tools.description: List and filter BookStack entities with pagination.

tools.name: bookstack_semantic_search
tools.description: Semantic or hybrid search across BookStack documents.

tools.name: bookstack_manage_images
tools.description: Unified create, read, update, delete, and list operations for gallery images.

tools.name: bookstack_search_images
tools.description: Advanced image discovery with extension, date, size, and usage filters.

tools.name: bookstack_batch_operations
tools.description: Bulk create, update, and delete operations for content entities.

tools.name: bookstack_get_metrics
tools.description: Expose runtime metrics for the BookStack MCP server.

tools.name: bookstack_health_check
tools.description: Return health information for the server and BookStack API.

tools.name: bookstack_dashboard
tools.description: Produce a human-friendly dashboard summarizing server status.
